correctness.rationale: Directly compute the inner-twist square and scalar centralizer. Reversal orbits of triangular positions, normalization of g_11 and invertibility of diagonal entries give a global coordinate presentation for every field and n>=2. For characteristic 2 and even n, the equations are epsilon^2=epsilon z_1=...=epsilon z_m=0; reduction, tangent excess, nonsmooth support and order-three obstruction follow by local ring calculations. Counting torus-affine points yields closed finite-field formulas. Embedded standalone exhaustive checker confirms the original anti-homomorphism identity and square-one on all matrix-unit pairs in seven finite prime-field configurations. Enumeration is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The scheme is a canonical unquotiented parameter space for algebra involutions on a natural family. Its smooth geometric reduction hides a codimension-m embedded infinitesimal singular locus and a concrete nonintegrable first-order deformation, a meaningful modular boundary invisible from field-valued equivalence classes. The point count illustrates the structural result but is not its sole motivation.
